description: Puts your offer into the live room, or updates the one already there: the product, more products as tiers, the special offer with its code and how long it holds. Take it when the room should show what you sell. A host says: "Put my course into the room with a code for the first hour." It needs the session and the webinar, a product from your own shop or the checkout address of a shop on another domain, and the way you sell: own shop, another WebinarIgnition site, or an outside provider like Digistore, Freemius or Stripe. It writes on your site and a voucher code is created in your own shop, so say that before you write. The answer says whether the offer really stands in the room; false means it does not. Side effect: it acts on your connected WordPress site; nothing else is touched. Words hosts use: put the offer in, product in the room, voucher code, offer in the room

affiliate.description: The host's affiliate id, if they sell as an affiliate. An empty string removes a stored one.

coupon.description: Your own voucher code, or leave it out to let WebinarIgnition create one.

offers.description: Further products of the same offer, in the order they should appear.

price.description: The webinar price as the voucher value: 50 with percent means 50 percent off, 99 with fixed means 99 off. Leave it out and no voucher is created.

price_type.description: How the price value is meant. Default percent.

product.description: Product ids from this site's shop, e.g. 296 or "296,297", or the checkout address of a shop on another domain. Never invented.

replace_visible.description: Special case only: true only after the host explicitly agreed to replace the offer that is already visible in the room.

route.description: own is this site's WooCommerce, other is a WebinarIgnition shop on another domain, external is any other provider where nothing is appended to the link.

session_id.description: From an earlier turn (weiter · texte · stand).

shop_url.description: The checkout address, when product carries ids and the shop is not this site's own.

site.description: Which connected site is meant when this chat has more than one: the address exactly as wi_get_connector_status lists it under sites. Leave it out while only one site is connected.

webinar_id.description: The webinar (campaign) id, as wi_list_webinars returned it. Never invent an id.

window.description: How long the webinar price holds: {start, end} as YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM in the site clock. Leave it out and it runs to the end of the webinar.

name: wi_change_webinar_offer
title: Put the offer into the webinar room
